description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users in both identity tenants (government-community and commercial)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every CUI system (GCEE, plant enclaves, SYS-D3, SYS-D4) federates to the government-community tenant; no sign-in means no PLM, no MES release, and no platform administration
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system with hardware keys; cached MES terminal credentials at each plant for released jobs
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below; a single outage stops all three divisions at once

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub network
description: Government-community landing zone (provider A) for CUI workloads and commercial landing zone (provider B): hub networks, guardrails, keys, logging, backup vaults
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The GCEE, SYS-D3, SYS-D4, and the SIEM run behind the provider A hub
manual_workaround: Provider A paired-region failover for the GCEE; SYS-D3 and SYS-D4 warm standby regions
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: GCEE (Aircraft Parts and Engineering Services); SYS-D3 and SYS-D4 (Defense Software); SIEM

description: Links and site VPNs from 9 plants and 4 engineering centers to the provider A hub
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Plants cannot pull new released documents from PLM, and engineering centers cannot reach the GCEE, without connectivity
manual_workaround: Second carrier at plants 1 to 8; cellular backup at engineering centers; released jobs keep running on MES
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All plants and centers; Plant 9 still has a single legacy circuit

business_process: Security monitoring, incident response, and DoD reporting
description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, incident handling, and the evidence needed for DIBNet reports and 90-day preservation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The 72-hour DoD reporting clock (DFARS 252.204-7012(c)) and Form 8-K Item 1.05 timing keep running during an outage; blind spots let exfiltration continue
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; EDR console reachable from the provider B break-glass account; reports filed from clean laptops with medium assurance certificates
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
dependent_people_or_facilities: SOC analysts; division liaisons; certificate holders
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and for the facts in every DoD, customer, and SEC notice

description: Customer orders, purchasing, inventory, shipping documents, and DCAA-compliant cost accounting for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Plants cannot ship or receive without order and shipping documents; DoD spares deliveries are measured daily
manual_workaround: Paper shipping packets from the daily ERP extract; manual receiving log
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Aircraft Parts shipping (BP-AP06) and purchasing; Engineering Services timekeeping and billing

description: Government-community email, file storage, and chat used for CUI correspondence with primes, DoD, and suppliers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Engineering change coordination and prime correspondence slow down but PLM and MES keep working
manual_workaround: Phone; PLM workflow comments; SFTP gateway for urgent file exchange
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Aircraft Parts and Engineering Services CUI correspondence; Defense Software customer CUI support cases

description: Verify U.S.-person status before CUI access; licenses, technical assistance agreements, and shipment screening
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New access and export shipments stop without it; existing access keeps working
manual_workaround: Hold new access requests and export shipments; Empowered Officials approve urgent cases by hand
dependent_systems: SYS-G1 identity attributes; export compliance application
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All CUI onboarding in every division; Aircraft Parts export shipments

description: Quarterly close, SEC filings, and disclosure committee support
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines are fixed; a material incident may itself require a Form 8-K within 4 business days of the materiality determination
manual_workaround: Close from the last ERP extract; outside counsel support for filings
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Draws on every division; the disclosure committee needs SOC facts during an incident

description: Payroll for 45,000 employees, onboarding, terminations, training records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs every two weeks; terminations feed same-day account removal
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll with adjustments; manual termination notices to identity team
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Termination events drive account removal in every CUI environment

description: Release of work orders, travelers, drawing views, and NC programs to machines at 9 plants (MES and DNC)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $45.6 million of shipments per production day; machines run loaded jobs for about one shift; a wrong NC program revision can produce a nonconforming flight part
manual_workaround: Run jobs already loaded; paper travelers printed from the last MES extract; no new release without revision check against PLM
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 MES and DNC; GCEE (released documents)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs SYS-G1, SYS-G3 network, and BP-AP03 PLM releases; feeds BP-AP06 shipping

business_process: Engineering design and change control (GCEE PLM)
description: PLM vault, CAD virtual workstations, release and change workflows for Aircraft Parts and Engineering Services
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: All 9 plants and Engineering Services depend on PLM releases; about 4.8 million controlled documents; engineering changes from primes carry delivery dates
manual_workaround: Released jobs continue from MES copies; urgent changes held until PLM returns
dependent_third_parties: PLM software vendor; cloud provider A
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: The SSP system (P02); inherits identity, network, and SOC from SYS-G1 to SYS-G3

business_process: Shipping and delivery of DoD spares and production parts
description: Packing, certification of conformance, and shipment of parts to DoD depots, primes, and commercial customers
process_owner: Aircraft Parts VP of supply chain
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DoD spares support aircraft readiness; prime delivery ratings are scored daily
manual_workaround: Paper shipping packets and certificates from the daily extract
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-G06 ERP; DoD and prime customers depend on it

description: CMM inspection, first article inspection, and acceptance records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A missing or wrong inspection record means product cannot be accepted; integrity matters as much as availability
manual_workaround: Manual inspection with paper records; CMM programs run locally
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 CMMs and quality records; GCEE (inspection plans)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses PLM inspection plans from the GCEE

business_process: Contracts, prime notices, and DoD reporting liaison
description: Contract flowdowns, SPRS submissions, notices to primes and contracting officers, DIBNet reports for Aircraft Parts contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The DoD reporting clock does not stop during an outage; reports must be possible from outside the CUI environment
manual_workaround: Clean laptops kept by certificate holders; printed contact lists in the incident binder
dependent_systems: None for the report itself (clean laptop); SYS-G4 for contract data
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Relies on SOC facts (BP-G02); coordinates with Engineering Services and Defense Software reporters

business_process: NC programming and additive build preparation
description: CAM programming, build file preparation, and program release to DNC
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New part starts wait for programs; existing released programs keep running
manual_workaround: Prioritize released programs; defer new starts
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-AP03 PLM

business_process: CUI exchange with primes, DoD, and suppliers
description: Drawing and model exchange through prime portals, the engineering data exchange gateway, and the CUI suite
process_owner: Aircraft Parts director of supply chain
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Exchanges are batched daily; primes accept short delays
manual_workaround: Defer non-urgent exchanges; prime portals reached from GCEE virtual desktops
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses SYS-G5 and the GCEE gateway

description: Flowdown checks, supplier CUI release, outside processing (heat treat, plating, testing) for about 1,450 suppliers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outside processing is scheduled in weekly lots
manual_workaround: Hold CUI releases; release only to suppliers already verified
dependent_systems: SYS-G4 supplier records; GCEE exchange gateway
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Supplier verification relies on BP-G07 and contract data

description: Instrumented ground and flight test data capture and storage for DoD programs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Test events are scheduled with DoD ranges and aircraft months ahead; lost data means repeating a test
manual_workaround: Local buffering on acquisition units; delay the next test event
dependent_systems: SYS-D2 test and evaluation systems; GCEE (test reports)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs SYS-G1 and SYS-G3 to move data into the GCEE

description: Design, stress analysis, and sustainment engineering deliverables in the GCEE
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deliverables are due in days or weeks; a short outage slows but does not stop work
manual_workaround: Work on cached models in CAD virtual workstations; defer submissions
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Shares the GCEE with Aircraft Parts

business_process: On-site engineering support at customer sites
description: About 1,200 engineers working on customer sites with GFE and customer systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers own most systems used on site; company laptops are needed for time, email, and the GCEE
manual_workaround: Use customer systems for customer work; phone for company coordination
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: GFE inventory gap (scenario gap 5)

description: Structural and fluid simulation runs on the HPC cluster
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Simulations are batch jobs; re-runs cost compute time, not safety

description: Proposal preparation and formal submission of deliverables to customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Proposal deadlines are known in advance and can be met from other centers

shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses group collaboration services

description: Fleet maintenance and readiness analytics for 5 DoD program offices, operated on behalf of DoD
process_owner: Defense Software general manager, DoD edition
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Program offices use it for daily readiness reporting; contract service levels and DFARS 252.239-7010 apply

shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Inherits SYS-G1, SYS-G2, SYS-G3 common controls; separate authorization boundary

process_owner: Defense Software general manager, industry edition

manual_workaround: Customer exports of the last daily snapshot
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Aircraft Parts is a customer; Engineering Services engineers hold user accounts in prime tenants

description: Support desk, customer communications, and contractual incident notices for both editions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer contracts set notice times; DoD reporting for the DoD edition runs through DIBNet
manual_workaround: Phone tree and out-of-band email list held by the support director
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Relies on SOC facts (BP-G02)

description: Source control, build, test, signing, and release for both editions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Releases can wait; a compromised pipeline is a bigger risk than an outage
manual_workaround: Freeze releases; emergency fixes by a documented manual build
dependent_third_parties: Source control and pipeline SaaS vendors

description: AI model that scores component removal risk in both editions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Maintainers can plan without scores; model output never grounds an aircraft by itself
